config.notes:
SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-18: CQL — List Operators Part 1. Test these items: Contains(list, element), Distinct(list), Equal (List), Equivalent (List), Except (List), Exists(list), Flatten(list), First(list), In(element, list), Includes(list), Included In (list), IndexOf(list, element), Intersect (List). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B: Equal for Code/Concept uses tuple equality by element name; List Equal uses element equality in order.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/cql18_historian_probe.py: CQLListElementEqual(json({code,system,display}), json({display,system,code})) returned false across forced Python, native-loaded, and no-Python C++ paths; expected true. Code with missing display compared to Code with display returned false; expected null because clinical equality with different components specified is unknown.
issues.root_cause: CQLListElementEqual compared Code/Concept-shaped JSON after raw serialization equality, so object key order and missing optional clinical components did not follow CQL tuple equality semantics.
issues.resolution: Added structured clinical equality macros for Code and Concept values and routed list element equality through them before raw JSON comparison.
issues.verified_in: Fresh probe, list parity 8/8, list part1+part2 14/14, official list parser 212/212, full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B: Equal returns null when equality cannot be determined; Quantity equality returns null for incompatible dimensions; List operators use element equality semantics.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/cql18_historian_probe.py: CQLListEqualEq([1 cm], [1 cm2]) and CQLListContainsEq([1 cm], 1 cm2) returned false across forced Python, native-loaded, and no-Python C++ paths; expected null because quantityCompare returns NULL for incompatible dimensions.
issues.root_cause: CQLListElementEqual wrapped quantityCompare(..., ==) in COALESCE(..., FALSE), erasing incompatible-dimension unknown/null equality results.
issues.resolution: Preserved quantityCompare NULL results and made list contains/includes/equality helpers propagate unknown when no definitive true/false result exists.
issues.verified_in: Fresh probe, list parity 8/8, list part1+part2 14/14, official list parser 212/212, full conformance 2822/2822.
